tools: approved multimodal Decisions model with one closed evidence classification; explicit generative alternative
limits: campaign review and shared stage budget; no acquisition outside declared source; no repair generation
authority: Classify observable evidence; runtime interprets the result under the frozen source/candidate review mode. Cannot change limits or tools.
content_scope: gambling eligible; explicit adult content, access blocks, parked pages and spam redirects excluded
baseline: Verify a reproducible user-facing source and report resource or control defects for recovery before repair. Do not infer unseen backend behavior.
candidate: Assess observable usability, imagery, controls and composition under the assigned intervention. P1/P2 preserve recognizable source design; P3/P4 may redesign. In diagnostic mode findings guide correction and are reported, without rejecting a measured proposal.
